requirements.title: AI Enhancement Breadth
requirements.description: Colorize, old-photo restore, face restoration (standalone op), Segment Anything (SAM), and depth/normal map via opt-in installs with CPU-capable defaults where feasible. SHIPPED: SAM (the selection domain's segment op, built-in region-grow + seeded SAM upgrade), colorize and depth_map (onnxruntime CPU sidecar modules colorize.py/depth.py, seeded ddcolor/depth-anything; wired into the AI catalog + submit edge + CLI). REMAINING (forward-declared, seeded, not yet wired): face_restore, old_photo_restore (torch python-sidecar), normal_map (computed-from-depth).

validation.notes: colorize + depth_map registered in the AI catalog (enhancement, RequiresImage) and each gets a dispatcher runner.
colorize + depth_map dispatch through the onnxruntime CPU sidecar (image_tools_sidecar.colorize / .depth).
SAM segmentation (the selection domain) produces masks that feed inpaint/object-removal. face_restore/old_photo_restore/normal_map remain forward-declared (seeded, unwired).
